title: spec(protocol): the `disabledActions` describe text still sends admins to the retired Setup › Packaged automation page (item 4 of #29374)
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbaBjisxkQo9hht9bFB

Carries item 4 of #29374; #29374 keeps items 1, 2, 3 and 5. Split by the `domain:devx` seat, which lands #29374, because triage (6580463328) anchors this describe edit to `domain:spec`. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

Part of #28236 (child N-31) · governs: ADR-0146 D4 (the packaged-action switch stays in Setup), D11 (Packaged automation retired).

## What is wrong

`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts:755` (read on `origin/main` at `7f277a86`) describes `disabledActions` as actions an administrator "turned them off under Setup › Packaged automation". That page is retired (N-28, #28578). Packaged actions are switched under Setup's `Packaged Actions` entry (`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup-nav.contributions.ts`). The describe text generates `content/docs/references/api/app-bundle.mdx` and `protocol.mdx`, so the published API reference repeats the dead path.

Re-check: `git grep -n 'Packaged automation' origin/main -- packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`

## Wanted

- Point the describe text at Setup's Packaged Actions, in plain words, no ADR or tracker number.
- Regenerate the spec artifacts (the two `.mdx` references above) in the same PR.
- Words only: the `ACTION_DISABLED` envelope code and the field's shape do not change. A patch changeset on `@objectstack/spec`.

## Serial note

Open PR #29218 also edits `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts` (another region). The sibling #29374 PR changes the refusal sentence in `packages/types/src/packaged-item-turned-off.ts`; keep both wordings consistent (actions → Setup › Packaged Actions).

Dedupe: searched `disabledActions Packaged automation` (open and closed): only #29374. **New.**
